subject: Temporary tiered-response policy & handoff procedures request
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@openfin.co>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@openfin.co
Date: 2026-11-22T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: temporary tiered response policy during year-end run

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our platform ops team. We have a concentrated release window from 2026-12-18 through 2027-01-05 where our traffic will spike and our SREs will be on-call with reduced headcount due to holidays. Our procurement/legal team would like a short-term carveout in the support response policy for that period allowing OpenFin to accept a tiered response SLA (extended P1 acknowledgement window during overnight hours, with guaranteed engineer engagement within X hours if escalation criteria met).

Can Redwood provide a temporary policy change (30 days max) and an agreed handoff procedure for our night shift (US PST) so we can update internal runbooks? We’d also like to document the escalation path (who gets paged at what threshold) and any cost/invoice adjustments for dedicated on-call coverage.

I attached a one-page note from our SRE describing the constraints (Attachment: oncall-handoff-rotas.csv). Let me know what you need from our side.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Jenkins
Director, Platform Engineering | OpenFin
(sara.jenkins@openfin.co)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@openfin.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary tiered response policy during year-end run

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the rotas file. We can support a time-limited adjustment but need to confirm the exact thresholds and fallback behavior. Proposed approach: 

- Tiered acknowledgement window: P1 acknowledgement within 30 minutes during core hours (08:00–20:00 PST), extended to 90 minutes overnight (20:00–08:00 PST) for 2026-12-18 -> 2027-01-05.
- P1 engineer engagement: if the incident meets our P1 severity (production outage affecting >25% of requests) we’ll ensure engineer engagement within 2 hours overnight; otherwise, a mitigations-only action (rate-limiting, temporary rollback) will be executed by on-call.
- P2: standard 4-hour acknowledgement window unchanged.
- Escalation path: on-call -> team lead -> designated incident manager (Redwood) -> OpenFin on-call primary. If no ack within window, page next tier and create temporary cross-account bridge.

I’m looping Ben and Neha to weigh in on cost and operational feasibility. Ben — can we cover the increased off-hours exposure with a temporary on-call premium for the dates above? Neha — any compliance concerns with the shorter P1 guarantee overnight?

I’m attaching a draft amendment with the wording we’d propose for the support contract (Attachment: sla-amendment-draft.pdf). If you’re comfortable we can fast-track legal review but need a go/no-go from Ben and Neha to commit.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary tiered response policy during year-end run

Quick notes from finance/ops:

- We can offer a temporary operational amendment for 2026-12-18 -> 2027-01-05 with a 15% nightly on-call premium for the dedicated engineer coverage and the extended acknowledgement window. That premium covers staffing/backfill and paged-response commitments.
- We should include a hard cap on cross-account bridge hours billable to OpenFin (suggested cap: 40 bridge-hours total across the window).
- Recommend including an automatic rollback clause if we observe >2 severity-impact incidents in a 72-hour sliding window; if so, we trigger immediate escalation to execs on both sides and revert to the standard SLA while we put escalation resources in place.

Marcus — can you confirm we have roster capacity for the extra pages at those premium rates? Neha — please confirm there are no SOC/audit blockers with the amendment language.

Ben
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@openfin.co>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary tiered response policy during year-end run

Sara / Kimberly — quick compliance and ops confirmation: 

- Compliance: temporary extension of overnight acknowledgement windows is acceptable provided we record the amendment and maintain audit logs for all incident handoffs. We’ll need OpenFin to sign the amendment and acknowledge the elevated on-call premium.
- Ops: Marcus confirmed capacity; we’ll allocate a dedicated backup engineer per night and provide a named escalation manager reachable by phone.

Next steps I recommend: 
1) Sara, confirm OpenFin agrees to the 15% nightly premium and the 40-hour bridge cap.
2) Once confirmed, we’ll send a redline-ready amendment (finalized by Redwood legal) for signature and add the temporary handoff rota to the incident runbook.

(Attachment: sla-amendment-draft.pdf referenced above)

Thanks — Neha Kapoor
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
